rigid.q: What part of speech is RIGID in: 'The rigid ruler would not bend.'?
rigid.hint: The answer is "adjective". It describes the ruler, and describing words are adjectives.

rigid.q: Which of these words from the sentence is an adjective: 'The rigid fence stood by the barn.'?
rigid.hint: The answer is "rigid". Rigid tells what kind of fence it is.

rigid.q: A word that describes a noun is an adjective. Which kind of word is RIGID?
rigid.hint: The answer is "adjective". Rigid describes how stiff something is.

rigid.q: Which word is an adjective: rigid, tractor, examine?
rigid.hint: The answer is "rigid". Tractor is a noun and examine is a verb, but rigid describes things.

rigid.q: In 'My new boots feel rigid,' RIGID describes the boots. What part of speech is it?
rigid.hint: The answer is "adjective". Words that describe nouns are adjectives.

rigid.q: What does RIGID mean?
rigid.hint: The answer is "stiff and hard to bend". Something rigid will not bend easily.

rigid.q: Read: 'The rigid cardboard would not fold into the box.' What does RIGID mean here?
rigid.hint: The answer is "stiff, not bendy". The cardboard was too stiff to fold.

rigid.q: Which word means almost the same as RIGID?
rigid.hint: The answer is "stiff". Stiff things are hard to bend, just like rigid things.

rigid.q: Which word means the opposite of RIGID?
rigid.hint: The answer is "bendy". Bendy things bend easily, but rigid things do not.

rigid.q: Which of these is an example of something rigid?
rigid.hint: The answer is "a metal pole". A metal pole is stiff and does not bend.

rigid.q: If a toy is rigid, what happens when you try to bend it?
options: It stretches like a rubber band.
It stays stiff and won't bend.
rigid.hint: The answer is "It stays stiff and won't bend.". Rigid means stiff and hard to bend.

rigid.q: The ice-cold metal bar was ____ and would not bend.
rigid.hint: The answer is "rigid". A bar that won't bend is rigid.

rigid.q: Which sentence uses RIGID correctly?
options: The rigid plank did not bend when I stood on it.
The pillow was so rigid that it felt soft and fluffy.
My rigid rubber band stretched across the room.
rigid.hint: The answer is "The rigid plank did not bend when I stood on it.". A plank that does not bend is rigid.

rigid.q: Which word fits: A frozen towel is so stiff that it cannot fold. The towel is ____.
rigid.hint: The answer is "rigid". Something too stiff to fold is rigid.

rigid.q: Sam's cast was ____ so his broken arm could not bend.
rigid.hint: The answer is "rigid". A hard cast is rigid so it holds the arm still.

rigid.q: Which of these sentences uses RIGID correctly?
options: The rigid jelly wiggled and jiggled on the plate.
Grandpa's old leather belt was so rigid it would not curl up.
The rigid scarf flowed softly in the wind.
rigid.hint: The answer is "Grandpa's old leather belt was so rigid it would not curl up.". A belt that will not curl is stiff, or rigid.

rigid.q: Which is the correct spelling?
rigid.hint: The answer is "rigid". Rigid is spelled r-i-g-i-d.

rigid.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'The ____ board did not bend.'
rigid.hint: The answer is "rigid". Rigid ends with a d, not a t, and has no extra d in the middle.

rigid.q: Fill the missing letters: r_g_d
rigid.hint: The answer is "i and i". Both missing letters are i: r-i-g-i-d.

rigid.q: Which word is spelled the right way?
rigid.hint: The answer is "rigid". Rigid has just one d at the end and an i before it.

fierce.q: What part of speech is FIERCE in: 'The fierce wind shook the barn.'?
fierce.hint: The answer is "adjective". Fierce describes the wind, so it is an adjective.

fierce.q: Which of these words from the sentence is an adjective: 'The fierce dog barked at the gate.'?
fierce.hint: The answer is "fierce". Fierce tells what kind of dog it is.

fierce.q: A word that describes a noun is an adjective. Which kind of word is FIERCE?
fierce.hint: The answer is "adjective". Fierce describes animals, storms, and other nouns.

fierce.q: Which word is an adjective: fierce, salary, disappear?
fierce.hint: The answer is "fierce". Salary is a noun and disappear is a verb, but fierce is a describing word.

fierce.q: In 'The lion gave a fierce roar,' what part of speech is FIERCE?
fierce.hint: The answer is "adjective". Fierce tells what kind of roar it was.

fierce.q: What does FIERCE mean?
options: wild, angry, and ready to attack
fierce.hint: The answer is "wild, angry, and ready to attack". A fierce animal is wild and ready to attack.

fierce.q: Read: 'The fierce tiger growled at the zookeeper from behind the fence.' What does FIERCE mean here?
fierce.hint: The answer is "wild and angry". A growling tiger is wild and angry.

fierce.q: Which word means almost the same as FIERCE?
fierce.hint: The answer is "wild". Fierce animals are wild and angry.

fierce.q: Which word means the opposite of FIERCE?
fierce.hint: The answer is "gentle". Gentle animals are calm and kind, not fierce.

fierce.q: Which of these is most likely fierce?
fierce.hint: The answer is "a growling wolf". A growling wolf is wild and ready to attack.

fierce.q: If you saw a fierce dog behind a fence, what should you do?
options: Stay back and tell a grown-up.
fierce.hint: The answer is "Stay back and tell a grown-up.". A fierce dog might bite, so it is safest to stay away.

fierce.q: The ____ storm blew branches all over the yard.
fierce.hint: The answer is "fierce". A wild storm is fierce.

fierce.q: Which sentence uses FIERCE correctly?
options: Grandma baked a fierce pie for dessert.
The fierce bunny purred and fell asleep on my lap.
The fierce bear growled to guard her cubs.
fierce.hint: The answer is "The fierce bear growled to guard her cubs.". A growling, guarding bear is fierce.

fierce.q: Which word fits: A mother hen puffs up her feathers and pecks to keep a fox away from her chicks. She is ____.
fierce.hint: The answer is "fierce". Pecking to scare off a fox is fierce.

fierce.q: The ____ wolf showed its sharp teeth and growled.
fierce.hint: The answer is "fierce". A growling wolf is fierce.

fierce.q: Which of these sentences uses FIERCE correctly?
options: I wrapped my sandwich in fierce.
The fierce butterfly napped quietly on a flower.
The fierce shark swam fast after the fish.
fierce.hint: The answer is "The fierce shark swam fast after the fish.". A shark chasing fish is fierce.

fierce.q: Which is the correct spelling?
fierce.hint: The answer is "fierce". Fierce has i before e and ends with -ce.

fierce.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'The ____ dog growled.'
fierce.hint: The answer is "fierce". Fierce is spelled f-i-e-r-c-e.

fierce.q: Fill the missing letters: f__rce
fierce.hint: The answer is "ie". Fierce has i then e: f-i-e-r-c-e.

fierce.q: Which word is spelled the right way?
fierce.hint: The answer is "fierce". Fierce ends with a silent e and has no extra a.

laughter.q: What part of speech is LAUGHTER in: 'Laughter filled the classroom.'?
laughter.hint: The answer is "noun". Laughter names a thing, a sound, so it is a noun.

laughter.q: A noun names a person, place, thing, or idea. Which kind of word is LAUGHTER?
laughter.hint: The answer is "noun". Laughter names a sound, which is a thing.

laughter.q: Which word is a noun: laughter, jovial, disappear?
laughter.hint: The answer is "laughter". Jovial is an adjective and disappear is a verb, but laughter names a thing.

laughter.q: Which of these words from the sentence is a noun: 'We heard loud laughter.'?
laughter.hint: The answer is "laughter". Laughter is the thing we heard.

laughter.q: LAUGHTER comes from the verb laugh. What part of speech is LAUGHTER?
laughter.hint: The answer is "noun". Laugh is the action, and laughter is the name of the sound.

laughter.q: What does LAUGHTER mean?
laughter.hint: The answer is "the sound of laughing". Laughter is the sound people make when they laugh.

laughter.q: Read: 'The clown's silly tricks filled the tent with laughter.' What does LAUGHTER mean here?
laughter.hint: The answer is "the sound of people laughing". Silly tricks make people laugh.

laughter.q: Which word means almost the same as LAUGHTER?
laughter.hint: The answer is "giggles". Giggles are a kind of laughing sound.

laughter.q: Which word means the opposite of LAUGHTER?
laughter.hint: The answer is "crying". Crying is the opposite of laughing.

laughter.q: Which of these is an example of laughter?
laughter.hint: The answer is ""Ha ha ha!"". Ha ha ha is the sound of laughing.

laughter.q: Where would you most likely hear laughter?
options: in a quiet library during a test
laughter.hint: The answer is "at a funny puppet show". Funny shows make people laugh.

laughter.q: The funny joke made the whole class burst into ____.
laughter.hint: The answer is "laughter". People burst into laughter when something is funny.

laughter.q: Which sentence uses LAUGHTER correctly?
options: Laughter rang out when the puppy chased its tail.
I poured laughter into my cereal bowl.
I tied my shoes with a long piece of laughter.
laughter.hint: The answer is "Laughter rang out when the puppy chased its tail.". Laughter is a sound you can hear.

laughter.q: Which word fits: At the party, everyone giggled at the silly magic trick. The room was full of ____.
laughter.hint: The answer is "laughter". Giggling fills a room with laughter.

laughter.q: Grandpa's ____ was so loud that we all started laughing too.
laughter.hint: The answer is "laughter". Loud laughing is laughter.

laughter.q: Which of these sentences uses LAUGHTER correctly?
options: The laughter fell off the tree in the fall.
Mom parked the laughter in the garage.
The baby's laughter made everyone smile.
laughter.hint: The answer is "The baby's laughter made everyone smile.". A baby's laugh is a happy sound.

laughter.q: Which is the correct spelling?
laughter.hint: The answer is "laughter". Laughter is spelled with augh, like laugh.

laughter.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'Our ____ filled the room.'
laughter.hint: The answer is "laughter". Laughter has augh and ends with -er.

laughter.q: Fill the missing letters: la_ght_r
laughter.hint: The answer is "u and e". Laughter is l-a-u-g-h-t-e-r.

laughter.q: Which word is spelled the right way?
laughter.hint: The answer is "laughter". Laughter starts with laugh, so it keeps the a-u-g-h.

salary.q: What part of speech is SALARY in: 'Mom's salary pays for our food.'?
salary.hint: The answer is "noun". Salary names a thing, money, so it is a noun.

salary.q: A noun names a person, place, thing, or idea. Which kind of word is SALARY?
salary.hint: The answer is "noun". A salary is a thing: money paid for a job.

salary.q: Which word is a noun: salary, jovial, examine?
salary.hint: The answer is "salary". Jovial is an adjective and examine is a verb, but salary names a thing.

salary.q: Which of these words from the sentence is a noun: 'Her salary is paid each month.'?
salary.hint: The answer is "salary". Salary is the thing that gets paid.

salary.q: Is SALARY a singular noun or a plural noun?
salary.hint: The answer is "singular noun". Salary names just one thing; the plural would be salaries.

salary.q: What is a SALARY?
options: money paid regularly to someone for their job
salary.hint: The answer is "money paid regularly to someone for their job". A salary is the money a worker earns.

salary.q: Read: 'The teacher uses her salary to pay her bills.' What does SALARY mean here?
options: money she earns from her job
salary.hint: The answer is "money she earns from her job". She pays bills with the money from her job.

salary.q: Which word means almost the same as SALARY?
salary.hint: The answer is "pay". Pay is money you get for working, just like a salary.

salary.q: Who is most likely to get a salary?
options: a puppy playing in the yard
a nurse who works at a hospital
salary.hint: The answer is "a nurse who works at a hospital". A nurse has a job and gets paid for it.

salary.q: What would a person most likely do with a salary?
options: use it to pay for food and a home
salary.hint: The answer is "use it to pay for food and a home". A salary is money, so you spend or save it.

salary.q: Which of these is an example of a salary?
options: A firefighter is paid money every two weeks for her job.
Grandma gives you five dollars for your birthday.
A boy finds a coin on the sidewalk.
salary.hint: The answer is "A firefighter is paid money every two weeks for her job.". A salary is regular pay for doing a job.

salary.q: Dad works at the bank and gets his ____ every month.
salary.hint: The answer is "salary". Money paid every month for a job is a salary.

salary.q: Which sentence uses SALARY correctly?
options: I ate a crunchy salary with peanut butter.
The coach earns a salary for training the team.
The salary hopped across the pond.
salary.hint: The answer is "The coach earns a salary for training the team.". A coach is paid a salary for his job.

salary.q: Which word fits: Mr. Lee works at the zoo, and the zoo pays him money every two weeks. That money is his ____.
salary.hint: The answer is "salary". Regular pay for a job is a salary.

salary.q: A pilot earns a ____ for flying planes.
salary.hint: The answer is "salary". Pilots are paid a salary for their work.

salary.q: Which of these sentences uses SALARY correctly?
options: My cat took a salary on the couch.
Aunt Rosa saved part of her salary to buy a new car.
The farmer planted salary in long rows.
salary.hint: The answer is "Aunt Rosa saved part of her salary to buy a new car.". You can save money from your salary.

salary.q: Which is the correct spelling?
salary.hint: The answer is "salary". Salary has one l and an a in the middle: s-a-l-a-r-y.

salary.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'Her ____ is paid on Fridays.'
salary.hint: The answer is "salary". Salary ends with -ary.

salary.q: Fill the missing letters: s_l_ry
salary.hint: The answer is "a and a". Salary is s-a-l-a-r-y.

salary.q: Which word is spelled the right way?
salary.hint: The answer is "salary". Salary has one l and two a's.

disappear.q: What part of speech is DISAPPEAR in: 'Watch the coin disappear!'?
disappear.hint: The answer is "verb". Disappear is something the coin does, so it is a verb.

disappear.q: A verb is an action word. Which kind of word is DISAPPEAR?
disappear.hint: The answer is "verb". Disappear tells an action: going out of sight.

disappear.q: Which word is a verb: disappear, salary, jovial?
disappear.hint: The answer is "disappear". Salary is a noun and jovial is an adjective, but disappear is an action.

disappear.q: Which of these words from the sentence is a verb: 'The bunnies disappear into the bushes.'?
disappear.hint: The answer is "disappear". Disappear tells what the bunnies do.

disappear.q: DISAPPEAR is made of dis- + appear. What part of speech is it?
disappear.hint: The answer is "verb". Appear is a verb, and adding dis- keeps it a verb.

disappear.q: What does DISAPPEAR mean?
disappear.hint: The answer is "to go out of sight". When something disappears, you can't see it anymore.

disappear.q: Read: 'The sun began to disappear behind the hills.' What does DISAPPEAR mean here?
disappear.hint: The answer is "go out of sight". The sun went behind the hills where we can't see it.

disappear.q: Which word means almost the same as DISAPPEAR?
disappear.hint: The answer is "vanish". Vanish also means to go out of sight.

disappear.q: Which word means the opposite of DISAPPEAR?
disappear.hint: The answer is "appear". Appear means to come into sight.

disappear.q: Which of these is an example of something disappearing?
options: A rainbow shows up in the sky.
A puppy runs into the room.
A magician waves a cloth and the bunny is gone.
disappear.hint: The answer is "A magician waves a cloth and the bunny is gone.". The bunny went out of sight.

disappear.q: What does a magician do to make a coin disappear?
options: hides it so you can't see it
drops it loudly on the floor
disappear.hint: The answer is "hides it so you can't see it". Disappear means to go out of sight.

disappear.q: When the wind blows, the clouds will ____ and the sun will shine.
disappear.hint: The answer is "disappear". Clouds that blow away go out of sight.

disappear.q: Which sentence uses DISAPPEAR correctly?
options: We ate a big bowl of disappear.
My snowman began to disappear as the sun melted it.
I will disappear the ball to my friend.
disappear.hint: The answer is "My snowman began to disappear as the sun melted it.". The melting snowman was going away.

disappear.q: Which word fits: The cookies were on the plate, but now the plate is empty. The cookies seemed to ____.
disappear.hint: The answer is "disappear". The cookies are gone, so they seemed to disappear.

disappear.q: The turtle pulled its head in so it would ____ inside its shell.
disappear.hint: The answer is "disappear". The turtle's head went out of sight.

disappear.q: Which of these sentences uses DISAPPEAR correctly?
options: The disappear barked at the mail carrier.
The stars disappear when the sun comes up.
Please disappear your coat on the hook.
disappear.hint: The answer is "The stars disappear when the sun comes up.". Stars go out of sight in daylight.

disappear.q: Which is the correct spelling?
disappear.hint: The answer is "disappear". Disappear is dis + appear: one s and two p's.

disappear.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'Watch the rabbit ____!'
disappear.hint: The answer is "disappear". Disappear ends with -ear, like appear.

disappear.q: Fill the missing letters: dis_ppe_r
disappear.hint: The answer is "a and a". Disappear is d-i-s-a-p-p-e-a-r.

disappear.q: Which word is spelled the right way?
disappear.hint: The answer is "disappear". Think dis + appear: one s, two p's, and -ear.

hurdler.q: What part of speech is HURDLER in: 'The hurdler won the race.'?
hurdler.hint: The answer is "noun". Hurdler names a person, so it is a noun.

hurdler.q: A noun can name a person. Which kind of word is HURDLER?
hurdler.hint: The answer is "noun". A hurdler is a person who runs and jumps.

hurdler.q: Which word is a noun: hurdler, disappear, jovial?
hurdler.hint: The answer is "hurdler". Disappear is a verb and jovial is an adjective, but hurdler names a person.

hurdler.q: HURDLER ends in -er, like runner and jumper. What part of speech is HURDLER?
hurdler.hint: The answer is "noun". Adding -er here makes a word that names a person.

hurdler.q: Is HURDLER a singular noun or a plural noun?
hurdler.hint: The answer is "singular noun". Hurdler names just one person; two would be hurdlers.

hurdler.q: What is a HURDLER?
options: a person who drives a tractor
a runner who jumps over barriers in a race
a big fish in the ocean
hurdler.hint: The answer is "a runner who jumps over barriers in a race". A hurdler runs and jumps over bars in a race.

hurdler.q: Read: 'At the track meet, the hurdler leaped over each bar.' What is a HURDLER?
options: a runner who jumps over bars
a coach who blows a whistle
hurdler.hint: The answer is "a runner who jumps over bars". The hurdler leaped over bars while racing.

hurdler.q: Which of these shows a hurdler in action?
options: Maya runs and jumps over a row of low fences in a race.
Maya swims laps in the pool.
Maya kicks a soccer ball into the goal.
hurdler.hint: The answer is "Maya runs and jumps over a row of low fences in a race.". Hurdlers jump over barriers while they run.

hurdler.q: Where would you most likely see a hurdler?
hurdler.hint: The answer is "at a track meet". Hurdlers race on a track.

hurdler.q: What does a hurdler need to be good at?
hurdler.hint: The answer is "running and jumping". Hurdlers run fast and jump over barriers.

hurdler.q: Which phrase means almost the same as HURDLER?
hurdler.hint: The answer is "a jumping runner". A hurdler runs and jumps.

hurdler.q: The ____ jumped over ten barriers to finish the race.
hurdler.hint: The answer is "hurdler". A runner who jumps barriers is a hurdler.

hurdler.q: Which sentence uses HURDLER correctly?
options: I put the hurdler in the oven to bake.
The hurdler cleared the last barrier and crossed the finish line.
The hurdler swam to the bottom of the ocean to find kelp.
hurdler.hint: The answer is "The hurdler cleared the last barrier and crossed the finish line.". Hurdlers jump barriers and race to the finish.

hurdler.q: Which word fits: Leo practices leaping over bars while sprinting on the track. Leo is a ____.
hurdler.hint: The answer is "hurdler". Leaping bars while running is what a hurdler does.

hurdler.q: My big sister is a fast ____ on the school track team.
hurdler.hint: The answer is "hurdler". A hurdler is a runner on a track team.

hurdler.q: Which of these sentences uses HURDLER correctly?
options: We looked up words in the hurdler.
The coach timed the hurdler as she jumped each fence.
The hurdler is the month after November.
hurdler.hint: The answer is "The coach timed the hurdler as she jumped each fence.". A hurdler jumps fences in a race.

hurdler.q: Which is the correct spelling?
hurdler.hint: The answer is "hurdler". Hurdler is hurdle plus r: h-u-r-d-l-e-r.

hurdler.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'The ____ jumped high.'
hurdler.hint: The answer is "hurdler". Hurdler starts with hur- and ends with -er.

hurdler.q: Fill the missing letters: h_rdl_r
hurdler.hint: The answer is "u and e". Hurdler is h-u-r-d-l-e-r.

hurdler.q: Which word is spelled the right way?
hurdler.hint: The answer is "hurdler". Hurdler has one d and ends with -er.

lounge.q: What part of speech is LOUNGE in: 'On Saturdays, I like to lounge on the couch.'?
lounge.hint: The answer is "verb". Here lounge is something I do, so it is a verb.

lounge.q: Which sentence uses LOUNGE as a verb?
options: We waited in the hotel lounge.
The cats lounge in the warm sun.
lounge.hint: The answer is "The cats lounge in the warm sun.". In the first sentence, lounge is what the cats do.

lounge.q: Which of these words from the sentence is a verb: 'The dogs lounge by the pool.'?
lounge.hint: The answer is "lounge". Lounge tells what the dogs do.

lounge.q: In 'Seals lounge on the warm rocks,' LOUNGE tells what the seals do. What part of speech is it?
lounge.hint: The answer is "verb". Words that tell what someone does are verbs.

lounge.q: A verb tells what someone does. In 'My cat loves to lounge on my bed,' which kind of word is LOUNGE?
lounge.hint: The answer is "verb". Lounge is the cat's action, so it is a verb.

lounge.q: What does LOUNGE mean in 'We lounge on the beach'?
options: to sit or lie in a lazy, relaxed way
lounge.hint: The answer is "to sit or lie in a lazy, relaxed way". To lounge is to relax lazily.

lounge.q: Read: 'On hot days, the dog likes to lounge in the shade.' What does LOUNGE mean here?
lounge.hint: The answer is "lie around and relax". The dog rests lazily in the shade.

lounge.q: Which word means almost the same as LOUNGE?
lounge.hint: The answer is "relax". To lounge is to relax in a lazy way.

lounge.q: Which means the opposite of LOUNGE?
lounge.hint: The answer is "rush around". Rushing around is busy, not lazy and relaxed.

lounge.q: Which of these is an example of lounging?
options: lying on a beach towel reading a comic
lounge.hint: The answer is "lying on a beach towel reading a comic". Lying around and reading is lazy and relaxed.

lounge.q: Which is the best place to lounge?
lounge.hint: The answer is "in a comfy hammock". A comfy hammock is a great place to relax.

lounge.q: After swimming, the seals ____ on the warm rocks.
lounge.hint: The answer is "lounge". Seals lie lazily on rocks to relax.

lounge.q: Which sentence uses LOUNGE correctly?
options: On Sunday we lounge in our pajamas and watch cartoons.
We lounge quickly to catch the bus before it leaves.
Please lounge your homework to the teacher.
lounge.hint: The answer is "On Sunday we lounge in our pajamas and watch cartoons.". Relaxing in pajamas is lounging.

lounge.q: Which word fits: Kim is lying in a hammock, just relaxing. Kim likes to ____.
lounge.hint: The answer is "lounge". Lying around relaxing is lounging.

lounge.q: The lazy cat likes to ____ on the sunny windowsill all day.
lounge.hint: The answer is "lounge". A lazy cat lies around and lounges.

lounge.q: Which of these sentences uses LOUNGE correctly?
options: The firefighters lounge into the house to help fast.
Grandma likes to lounge in her big chair after dinner.
I lounge my bike up the steep hill as hard as I can.
lounge.hint: The answer is "Grandma likes to lounge in her big chair after dinner.". Relaxing in a chair is lounging.

lounge.q: Which is the correct spelling?
lounge.hint: The answer is "lounge". Lounge has ou and ends with -ge.

lounge.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'We ____ by the pool.'
lounge.hint: The answer is "lounge". Lounge ends with a silent e after the g.

lounge.q: Fill the missing letters: l__nge
lounge.hint: The answer is "ou". Lounge is l-o-u-n-g-e.

lounge.q: Which word is spelled the right way?
lounge.hint: The answer is "lounge". Lounge is spelled l-o-u-n-g-e.

jovial.q: What part of speech is JOVIAL in: 'The jovial clown made us laugh.'?
jovial.hint: The answer is "adjective". Jovial describes the clown, so it is an adjective.

jovial.q: Which of these words from the sentence is an adjective: 'Our jovial coach smiled at the team.'?
jovial.hint: The answer is "jovial". Jovial tells what kind of coach.

jovial.q: A word that describes a noun is an adjective. Which kind of word is JOVIAL?
jovial.hint: The answer is "adjective". Jovial describes people and moods.

jovial.q: Which word is an adjective: jovial, hurdler, disappear?
jovial.hint: The answer is "jovial". Hurdler is a noun and disappear is a verb, but jovial is a describing word.

jovial.q: In 'Santa is jovial and kind,' JOVIAL describes Santa. What part of speech is it?
jovial.hint: The answer is "adjective". Words that describe nouns are adjectives.

jovial.q: What does JOVIAL mean?
options: cheerful and full of good fun
jovial.hint: The answer is "cheerful and full of good fun". A jovial person is cheerful and fun.

jovial.q: Read: 'The jovial bus driver sang songs and told jokes on the way to school.' What does JOVIAL mean here?
jovial.hint: The answer is "cheerful and fun". Singing and joking shows he is cheerful.

jovial.q: Which word means almost the same as JOVIAL?
jovial.hint: The answer is "cheerful". Jovial people are cheerful.

jovial.q: Which word means the opposite of JOVIAL?
jovial.hint: The answer is "grumpy". Grumpy is the opposite of cheerful and fun.

jovial.q: Who is acting jovial?
options: Uncle Joe frowns and won't talk.
Uncle Joe laughs, tells jokes, and makes everyone smile.
Uncle Joe is fast asleep on the couch.
jovial.hint: The answer is "Uncle Joe laughs, tells jokes, and makes everyone smile.". Laughing and joking is jovial.

jovial.q: Where would you most likely find jovial people?
options: in line for a shot at the doctor
jovial.hint: The answer is "at a fun birthday party". Parties are full of cheerful fun.

jovial.q: The ____ farmer whistled and waved at everyone who passed by.
jovial.hint: The answer is "jovial". A cheerful, friendly farmer is jovial.

jovial.q: Which sentence uses JOVIAL correctly?
options: The jovial puppy wagged its tail and played with everyone.
The jovial man yelled at the kids and slammed the door.
jovial.hint: The answer is "The jovial puppy wagged its tail and played with everyone.". A happy, playful puppy is jovial.

jovial.q: Which word fits: Mr. Diaz always smiles, laughs, and tells funny jokes. He is ____.
jovial.hint: The answer is "jovial". Smiling and joking means he is jovial.

jovial.q: Everyone loved the ____ lunch lady who greeted kids with a big smile.
jovial.hint: The answer is "jovial". A smiling, cheerful person is jovial.

jovial.q: Which of these sentences uses JOVIAL correctly?
options: The jovial rock sank to the bottom of the river.
The jovial girl cried because she was so sad.
Grandpa was in a jovial mood and told silly stories all night.
jovial.hint: The answer is "Grandpa was in a jovial mood and told silly stories all night.". Telling silly stories shows a jovial mood.

jovial.q: Which is the correct spelling?
jovial.hint: The answer is "jovial". Jovial is spelled j-o-v-i-a-l.

jovial.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'The ____ clown waved.'
jovial.hint: The answer is "jovial". Jovial ends with -ial.

jovial.q: Fill the missing letters: jov__l
jovial.hint: The answer is "ia". Jovial is j-o-v-i-a-l.

jovial.q: Which word is spelled the right way?
jovial.hint: The answer is "jovial". Jovial has one v and ends with -ial.

inferior.q: What part of speech is INFERIOR in: 'This cheap ball is inferior to my old one.'?
inferior.hint: The answer is "adjective". Inferior describes the ball, so it is an adjective.

inferior.q: Which of these words from the sentence is an adjective: 'The inferior glue did not hold.'?
inferior.hint: The answer is "inferior". Inferior tells what kind of glue.

inferior.q: In 'They sold inferior apples that were mushy,' INFERIOR describes the apples. What part of speech is it?
inferior.hint: The answer is "adjective". Words that describe nouns are adjectives.

inferior.q: In 'Dad would not buy the inferior kite,' what part of speech is INFERIOR?
inferior.hint: The answer is "adjective". Inferior tells what kind of kite.

inferior.q: What part of speech is INFERIOR in: 'Mom said the old tires were inferior.'?
inferior.hint: The answer is "adjective". Inferior describes the tires.

inferior.q: What does INFERIOR mean?
options: not as good; lower in quality
inferior.hint: The answer is "not as good; lower in quality". Inferior things are not as good as others.

inferior.q: Read: 'The inferior umbrella broke in the first light wind.' What does INFERIOR mean here?
inferior.hint: The answer is "not as good". It broke easily because it was not well made.

inferior.q: Which word means almost the same as INFERIOR?
inferior.hint: The answer is "worse". Inferior means not as good, or worse.

inferior.q: Which word means the opposite of INFERIOR?
inferior.hint: The answer is "better". Inferior means not as good, so better is the opposite.

inferior.q: Which of these crayons is inferior?
options: a crayon that breaks every time you color
a strong crayon that lasts all year
inferior.hint: The answer is "a crayon that breaks every time you color". A crayon that keeps breaking is not as good.

inferior.q: What would you most likely do with inferior shoes that fell apart in a week?
options: tell everyone they are the best shoes ever
return them for a better pair
inferior.hint: The answer is "return them for a better pair". Inferior things are not good, so you would want better ones.

inferior.q: The paper plates were ____, so they bent and spilled our food.
inferior.hint: The answer is "inferior". Plates that bend and spill are not as good.

inferior.q: Which sentence uses INFERIOR correctly?
options: Our team won first prize because our project was inferior.
I inferior my bike to school every day.
The cheap kite was inferior and ripped on its first flight.
inferior.hint: The answer is "The cheap kite was inferior and ripped on its first flight.". A kite that rips right away is not as good.

inferior.q: Which word fits: Ben's toy car broke in one day, but Ava's lasted for years. Ben's car was ____.
inferior.hint: The answer is "inferior". Ben's car was not as good as Ava's.

inferior.q: The farmer said the moldy hay was ____ and not good for the horses.
inferior.hint: The answer is "inferior". Moldy hay is lower in quality.

inferior.q: Which of these sentences uses INFERIOR correctly?
options: The inferior laughed and told a funny joke.
Mom would not buy the inferior bananas because they were brown and mushy.
The inferior cake won the blue ribbon for being the best.
inferior.hint: The answer is "Mom would not buy the inferior bananas because they were brown and mushy.". Mushy bananas are lower in quality.

inferior.q: Which is the correct spelling?
inferior.hint: The answer is "inferior". Inferior ends with -ior.

inferior.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'This tape is ____.'
inferior.hint: The answer is "inferior". Inferior starts with in- and has one r in the middle.

inferior.q: Fill the missing letters: inf_ri_r
inferior.hint: The answer is "e and o". Inferior is i-n-f-e-r-i-o-r.

inferior.q: Which word is spelled the right way?
inferior.hint: The answer is "inferior". Inferior is spelled i-n-f-e-r-i-o-r.

December.q: What part of speech is DECEMBER in: 'December is a cold month here.'?
December.hint: The answer is "noun". December names a month, so it is a noun.

December.q: A noun can name a special thing, like a month. Which kind of word is DECEMBER?
December.hint: The answer is "noun". December is the name of a month, and names are nouns.

December.q: Which word is a noun: December, jovial, disappear?
December.hint: The answer is "December". Jovial is an adjective and disappear is a verb, but December names a month.

December.q: Which of these words from the sentence is a noun: 'We sing songs in December.'?
December.hint: The answer is "December". December names a month.

December.q: Is DECEMBER a singular noun or a plural noun?
December.hint: The answer is "singular noun". December names just one month.

December.q: What is DECEMBER?
options: the first month of the year
the twelfth month of the year
December.hint: The answer is "the twelfth month of the year". December is month number twelve.

December.q: Read: 'My birthday is in December, right before the new year starts.' What is DECEMBER?
options: the last month of the year
December.hint: The answer is "the last month of the year". December is the last month before a new year.

December.q: Which month comes right before December?
December.hint: The answer is "November". November is the eleventh month, just before December.

December.q: Which month comes right after December?
December.hint: The answer is "January". After December, a new year starts with January.

December.q: Which of these days is in December?
options: New Year's Eve, the last day of the year
December.hint: The answer is "New Year's Eve, the last day of the year". New Year's Eve is December 31.

December.q: How many months come after December in the same year?
December.hint: The answer is "none". December is the twelfth and last month.

December.q: The last month of the year is ____.
December.hint: The answer is "December". December is month twelve, the last one.

December.q: Which sentence uses DECEMBER correctly?
options: In December, we hung lights and built a snowman.
December is the first month of the year.
I ate a bowl of December for lunch.
December.hint: The answer is "In December, we hung lights and built a snowman.". December is a winter month at the end of the year.

December.q: Which word fits: It comes after November and before January. It is ____.
December.hint: The answer is "December". December sits between November and January.

December.q: Our winter break starts in ____, right before New Year's Day.
December.hint: The answer is "December". Winter break often starts in December.

December.q: Which of these sentences uses DECEMBER correctly?
options: We December the cookies on a plate.
December.hint: The answer is "There are 31 days in December.". December has 31 days.

December.q: Which is the correct spelling?
December.hint: The answer is "December". December has a c, not an s, and ends with -ber.

December.q: Which is written correctly?
December.hint: The answer is "December". Months start with a capital letter, and December ends with -ber.

December.q: Which word is spelled correctly in the sentence? 'Snow fell all ____.'
December.hint: The answer is "December". December is spelled D-e-c-e-m-b-e-r.

December.q: Fill the missing letters: De_emb_r
December.hint: The answer is "c and e". December is D-e-c-e-m-b-e-r.
